mutations.name: a PR counts whole as upkeep when any path is, as a class tag would
mutations.replace: return testOnlyPr || files.some((file) => matchesAny(file, paths.upkeep)) ? files.length : 0;
kills: upkeep share by changed paths a factory-only, a console and a mixed PR give the share of upkeep files among all files changed

mutations.name: the cap holds only past the cap, not at it
kills: upkeep share by changed paths a share of exactly the cap holds, and one just under it does not

mutations.name: test files count as upkeep beside product code
mutations.find: const testOnlyPr = files.length > 0 && files.every((file) => matchesAny(file, paths.testOnly));
kills: test-only PR rule test files are upkeep in a PR that changed only tests, and product beside the code they test
